scope: JOINON / PUN partyId GES station-level direct tariff investigation

atlante.reason: 23/09 national snapshot already integrated; do not reimport or downgrade newer canonical state

newEvidence.finding: GEWISS states JOINON Charge&Go displays prices for the selected charging station and supports wallet/session management; this confirms a station-specific first-party tariff surface, not a uniform network tariff.
GEWISS again documents station information including prices, availability and charging-session controls.

Comune di Osio Sotto publishes a JOINON-app price of 0.50 EUR/kWh for its charging service, while other apps use their own pricing. This proves site/operator-specific pricing and must not be generalized to all IT*GES.

ChorusLife identifies JOINON charging stations and publishes local charging prices AC 0.45 EUR/kWh and DC 0.60 EUR/kWh, alongside market-reference prices AC 0.60 and DC 0.85 EUR/kWh. These are local ChorusLife tariffs and must not be generalized.

PUN-derived view exposes concrete IT*GES EVSE IDs IT*GES*E69R6D and IT*GES*EOA45U at Gallarate but reports tariffs not communicated to PUN. This provides concrete EVSE anchors for the next direct/app mapping step.

decision.reason: First-party evidence proves station-specific prices exist, and official anchors demonstrate materially different local prices. No deterministic mapping from the complete IT*GES EVSE perimeter to JOINON direct prices has yet been recovered.

nextAction: Use concrete IT*GES EVSE anchors (starting IT*GES*E69R6D / IT*GES*EOA45U) against the JOINON Charge&Go public/guest/app backend or QR/deeplink surface. Persist exact EVSE->direct-price mappings. Do not repeat broad JOINON tariff web search unless new first-party evidence appears.

antiRepeat.resumeCondition: concrete JOINON backend/QR/deeplink payload or official EVSE-scoped price evidence
